commands.name: search-media
commands.summary: Search NASA images, videos and audio by free text, keyword tags, NASA center, media type and year range (paged, 100 per page by default)

commands.name: get-asset
commands.summary: List the downloadable file URLs (original, large, medium, small, thumb; video encodings, captions, metadata) for a NASA media item

commands.name: get-metadata
commands.summary: Get the full technical and descriptive metadata (EXIF/QuickTime/AVAIL fields: dates, dimensions, duration, keywords, credits) of a NASA media item

commands.name: get-metadata-location
commands.summary: Resolve the URL of a media item's metadata.json via the official API (use when you don't know the item's media type)

commands.name: get-video-captions
commands.summary: Get the SRT caption/subtitle transcript of a NASA video

commands.name: get-album
commands.summary: List the media items in a named NASA album (e.g. Apollo), paged

commands.name: list-popular
commands.summary: List currently trending/popular media items shown on the home page

commands.name: list-recent
commands.summary: List the newest uploads to the NASA Image and Video Library
